values.note: The River Campground has 52 sites (Reserve Florida lists 45 bookable, 18 to 36 ft, two of them pull-through); the park's other family campground, Pine Grove (90 sites), is not part of this entry.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/jonathan-dickinson-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The River Campground, with 52 sites, is 4 miles from the park entrance'; 'Maximum RV length is ... 36 feet for the River Campground.') + Reserve Florida facility 82 (45 units, VehicleLength 18-36, 'Pull Through' on sites 109 and 114), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/jonathan-dickinson-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('All sites include water, electricity ...; sewer hookup is included on all Pine Grove campsites as well. A dump station is located at Pine Grove Campground, approximately 4 miles from the River Campground.') + Reserve Florida facility 82 (Electric Hookup 50 on all 45 units, no Sewer Hookup on any), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The dump station is at Pine Grove Campground, about 4 miles from the River Campground.

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/jonathan-dickinson-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Both campgrounds have large, tiled restrooms with hot showers and are each set up with a washer and dryer'; 'A dump station is located at Pine Grove Campground, approximately 4 miles from the River Campground'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations up to 11 months ahead (Florida residents; Reserve Florida opened 10 months ahead to an anonymous search on 2026-10-21), online or at 800-326-3521.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/jonathan-dickinson-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance. For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521') + Reserve Florida facility 82 restrictions (MinimumStay 1, MaximumStay 14, FutureBookingEnds 2027-08-21), read 2026-10-21

note: Park on the Loxahatchee River with two campgrounds, a nature boardwalk, observation tower, and kayaking options.  Campgrounds are not waterfront.  --AWH  Reserve Florida marks 17 or more River Campground sites 'This site floods in moderate to heavy rains' (read 2026-10-21). Since Oct. 2025 the River Campground's south bathhouses have been closed for renovation; the south family/ADA bathroom with shower and the north bathhouse are open (park page, read 2026-10-21). --Claude
summary: Park page + Reserve Florida (Loop RC): 52 sites to 36 ft with 2 pull-throughs, water + 50-amp at every site and no sewer (sewer is Pine Grove's), showers, washer/dryer, dump at Pine Grove 4 miles away; inherited reservable/operator/11-month window confirmed, 14-night max. Fees ($26 + $7) unchanged, matched by Reserve Florida's $26 rate today. Note: added the flood-prone sites and the bathhouse renovation. Not stated: season.
